provenance.host: Darwin arm64, Mac14,10, matches running concurrently
provenance.positions: twin self-game sample, one per distinct piece count
provenance.caveat: a FRESH Searcher() per rep, so BOTH tables start empty.  An in-game move is colder than that only in tp_score (sunfish.py:516 clears it per search) and WARMER in tp_move, which persists all game -- so this profile understates in-game nps and the surrogate searches slightly fewer nodes per virtual second than pypy would.  It is the same understatement on both arms of any A/B, so it compresses absolute depth without biasing a comparison.
